Game Overview

In Red and Green Pumpkin, the core idea is straightforward: venture into a pumpkin-laden realm where teamwork and strategy are your only escape. Maneuver through spine-chilling levels with precise timing and expert double jumps. Solve challenging puzzles and outsmart monstrous foes, making this thrilling cooperative adventure an absolute must-play for spook-seeking duos.
